headline: Antoine Semenyo happy to lead Man City's attack if needed
description: Antoine Semenyo is ready to take on the challenge of leading Manchester City's attack if needed.

headline: Lamine Camara better off in Monaco, ex-Chelsea midfielder says
description: Chelsea transfer target Lamine Camara has been told he is better off where he is by Monaco teammate and former Blues cast-off Denis Zakaria.

headline: Matheus Cunha urges calm after disproving 'Man United will go to Championship' fear
description: Matheus Cunha has said it's too early to write off Manchester United this season after reminding critics they were able to recover from a poor start a year ago to finish third in the Premier League.

headline: Ruben Amorim: 'I can't repeat my mistakes' after Man United
description: Ruben Amorim has vowed not to repeat the mistakes of his Manchester United tenure at AC Milan.

headline: Carrick has an impossible job at Man United after transfer failures
description: Manchester United's players aren't good enough and the club isn't doing enough to rectify that, so where does that leave manager Michael Carrick?

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal eye versatile Dortmund forward Beier
description: Arsenal are monitoring Borussia Dortmund forward Maximilian Beier as a potential attacking reinforcement. Transfer Talk has the latest.
